target.title: fix(gateway): clarify call params errors when JSON is malformed
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running `openclaw gateway call ... --params not-json` would see a raw JSON parse failure wrapped in the gateway call failure instead of a stable, flag-specific params diagnostic.

## Why This Change Was Made

The gateway call CLI now parses `--params` through a local boundary that reports malformed JSON as `--params must be valid JSON.` before any gateway transport is opened. This matches the existing `nodes invoke --params` malformed JSON boundary, stays inside the gateway CLI command owner, and does not change valid params handling, gateway RPC dispatch, config, schemas, or compatibility behavior.

## User Impact

Users get a concise, actionable CLI error for malformed gateway call params, and malformed params still stop before any gateway request is sent.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: current-head `gateway call` rejects malformed `--params` JSON with the stable params diagnostic before any gateway RPC transport is opened.
- Current head: `5de4fb5f985533199841c245fd599357fd0432a5`.
- Real CLI-path proof in `openclaw-lane-a`: registered the production gateway CLI command through Commander from source and parsed `openclaw gateway call status --params not-json --url http://127.0.0.1:9 --json` with `node --import tsx --input-type=module`.

Input script:

```js
import { Command } from "commander";
import { registerGatewayCli } from "./src/cli/gateway-cli.js";
const program = new Command().name("openclaw");
registerGatewayCli(program);
await program.parseAsync([
  "node",
  "openclaw",
  "gateway",
  "call",
  "status",
  "--params",
  "not-json",
  "--url",
  "http://127.0.0.1:9",
  "--json",
]);
```

Output:

```text
Gateway call failed: Error: --params must be valid JSON.
EXIT_CODE=1
```

- Focused regression: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/gateway-cli.coverage.test.ts -t "fails gateway call on invalid params JSON"` passed with 1 test passing and 30 skipped in `openclaw-lane-a`.
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Current CI note: the only red current-head check is `checks-node-compact-small-whole-1`, failing in unrelated `src/config/sessions/session-accessor.reply-init-concurrency.test.ts` with `Error: Test timed out in 15000ms`; this PR changes only `src/cli/gateway-cli/register.ts` and `src/cli/gateway-cli.coverage.test.ts`.
